cases.reason: The reader checked only the PERMITTED positions (none can be a CD record, since Annex A confines the facility to a program definition) and missed the FORBIDDEN ones. Because the communication section exists only in a program definition, every CD record is outside a factory/instance/method definition, so in 2002 SR15 forbids '01 COBJ USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE ACTIVE-CLASS' written under a CD (a level-1 elementary object reference there is otherwise admitted by SR13).
